info.title: Container Registry Client CLI
info.description: CLI for executing commands on a container registry's HTTP API.

commands.name: image
commands.description: Commands related to container images

commands.name: compare
commands.description: Compares two images. The layers comparison uses exit code 2 when differences are found; this is not a command failure.

commands.name: layers
commands.description: Compares two images by layers. Exit code 2 means layer differences were found, not a command failure.

commands.name: files
commands.description: Compares two images by their files

commands.name: metadata
commands.description: Compares two images by configuration and platform metadata

commands.name: ls
commands.description: Lists files in an image filesystem with layer provenance

commands.name: cat
commands.description: Writes a file from an image filesystem to standard output

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Image file path to write to standard output

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Extracts a file or directory from an image filesystem

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Image file or directory path to extract

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Returns low-level information on a container image

commands.name: os
commands.description: Gets OS info about the container image

commands.name: save-layers
commands.description: Saves an image's extracted layers to disk

commands.name: dockerfile
commands.description: Generates a Dockerfile that represents the image

commands.name: explore
commands.description: Interactively explore image layers, files, and insights

commands.name: manifest
commands.description: Commands related to manifests

commands.name: get
commands.description: Queries a manifest

commands.name: digest
commands.description: Queries the digest of a manifest

commands.name: resolve
commands.description: Resolves a manifest to a target platform's fully-qualified image digest

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Deletes a manifest and all tags pointing to it, without deleting child manifests or layers

commands.name: referrer
commands.description: Commands related to referrers

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists the referrers to a manifest

commands.name: check
commands.description: Checks for required OCI referrer artifact types. Exit code 2 means one or more required types are missing, not a command failure.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Inspects an OCI artifact referenced by an image

commands.name: get
commands.description: Retrieves a payload from an OCI artifact referenced by an image

commands.name: repo
commands.description: Commands related to container repositories

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists the repositories contained in the container registry

commands.name: tag
commands.description: Commands related to container image tags

commands.name: list
commands.description: Lists the tags contained in the container repository

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Deletes a tag without deleting its manifest or other tags

commands.name: settings
commands.description: Commands related to Dredge settings

commands.name: open
commands.description: Opens the Dredge settings file

commands.name: get
commands.description: Gets the value of the specified setting

commands.name: set
commands.description: Sets the specified setting name to a value

arguments.name: VALUE
arguments.description: Value to assign to the setting

commands.name: clear-cache
commands.description: Deletes the cached files used by Dredge
